projects.title: AI-powered Web Assistant
projects.description: A Flask assistant that turns messages into a structured summary, sentiment and reply.
projects.overview: A work-in-progress web assistant with a working chat flow. A simple browser interface sends a message to Flask; LangChain calls Gemini and Pydantic parses the response into summary, sentiment and reply fields.
features: Configurable model settings and basic error handling.

projects.title: Personal Task MCP Server
projects.description: A local task-management server exploring how AI applications connect to tools and data through MCP.
projects.overview: A hands-on learning project built around a small Python task manager. Custom MCP clients, Gemini and a Google ADK agent use the server's tools, resources and prompts. Local communication uses stdio, with task data stored in JSON.
features: Add, list, complete, delete and search tasks.
MCP tool discovery, resources and prompts.
Gemini and Google ADK client integrations.
projects.learned: I learned how MCP acts as a standard connection layer between AI applications and external tools, including tool discovery, invocation, resources, prompts and local stdio communication.

projects.title: Drive Smart 2.0
projects.description: A Windows desktop system for vehicle rentals, fleet maintenance, customers, payments and reports.
projects.overview: A modular Windows desktop application that brings day-to-day vehicle rental and fleet operations into one system. Employee roles control access to vehicle, customer, payment and maintenance modules, with SQLite persistence and operational reporting.
features: Employee authentication and Admin, Manager and Staff roles.
Vehicle, customer, payment and maintenance management.
Billing, PDF reports and Excel exports.

projects.title: Person Identifier
projects.description: A beginner-friendly face-recognition project using face embeddings and KNN to identify people.
projects.overview: A Python face-recognition project using OpenCV, face embeddings and KNN machine learning. The repository describes it as the first part of a larger AI and IoT project for identifying and interacting with people.
